gold_blinding: Fresh no-history Luna tasks, instructional file whitelist; shared filesystem is not OS isolation; parent loads gold solely for conversion/sampling and later evaluation
source_refresh: Public ArgUNSC snapshot archive and fixed-revision CasiMedicos files downloaded; CDCP existing author archive reused by verified hash
evaluation: Exact reconstructed character spans, native component types, full typed relation objects; no IoU/fuzzy prediction credit; every selected failure stays in denominator
candidate_protocol: Unchanged finite typed candidate constructor except additional binary corpus registry; punctuation trim; 4096 slot preflight cap; construction failures retained
scoring_protocol: separate gold-blind Luna scoring call; fixed per-object confidence as a heuristic proxy, not calibrated probability and not the trained MLP scorer from thesis
case_selection: fixed rule after full evaluation: first doc ID of improvement, harm, unchanged; enumerate unavailable categories

sampling.rule: length quartiles then SHA256(V10-LUNA-FIXED32|corpus|text), first 8 per stratum
sampling.stopping: all 32 per corpus; no outcome-dependent continuation

score_interpretation: Heuristic same-model confidence; not learned/calibrated scorer
implementation_changes: Native ArgUNSC/CasiMedicos binary schema registry and corresponding MCR claim node types
Sorted summation order for phi; same formula, acceptance gates, actions and budgets
Portable vendor path for nested experiment folder
statistical_scope: One model task realization per document; exploratory pilot, no significance/power or full-benchmark claims
